basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old health enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the freedom to explore my interests in nutrition and sports. I'm a huge fan of Formula 1—particularly Red Bull Racing—and a lifelong NY Giants supporter. In my free time, you'll find me either researching the latest in dietary supplements or catching up on the latest NFL games. Although I'm single, I enjoy a vibrant social life with friends who share my passion for motorsports and nutrition. I tend to be online late at night, from around 10 PM to 2 AM, when I do most of my reading and commenting.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Nutrition and have spent the last five years self-educating on dietary supplements and their physiological impacts. My knowledge is bolstered by attending webinars and participating in online forums. I also subscribe to several health journals to keep up with the latest research.
